notes: Fixes the nine issues reported for 1.3.2. Notifications are readable again and sit above dialogs. The setup wizard opens as a centred modal with its backdrop. Every segmented control shows the same filled pill for the chosen option. Switching language keeps Settings open and translates back to English in place. Past task lanes keep their cards at full contrast. The timetable tooltip no longer blinks between subjects. Data-pane primary buttons light up on hover instead of going dark. Tabs no longer flicker when switching quickly, and Install and restart opens Flip again after updating.
